t: Shanghai Daily: Museum honors a pioneer of Chinese design
s: Most of the textile designs in the exhibition were produced during the studio’s two-year operation in Shanghai. “Before the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression (1931-45), fabric printing factories only used patterns from abroad. My father thought we should have our own designers and design patterns,” Chen Xiufan said. Chen Zhifo’s Egyptian-style patterns became popular. Deng Bai, another of his students, said Chen drew inspiration from a wide range of cultures, pictorial art on Greek pottery, motifs on Persian carpets, Indian decorative paintings and the ancient murals in the Mogao Caves, brocade and embroidery designs from the Ming (1368-1644) and Qing (1644-1911) dynasties.
